issues.detail: The Greek 'ερωτησω' is a future tense verb (I will ask), but the Vietnamese 'hãy nói cho ta' (please tell me / speak to me) changes the action from an inquiry into a command/request for an answer.
The Greek 'ερωτησω υμας' means 'I will ask you'. The Vietnamese 'hãy nói cho ta' omits the act of the speaker asking and replaces it with a request for the listeners to speak.
